snowyowlmia-persona-compass-root.description: Build personality models of colleagues, clients, friends, or family members and get AI-powered communication strategies. Use this skill whenever the user wants to: understand someone's personality, predict how someone will react, get advice on communicating with a difficult person, prepare for a tough conversation, navigate office politics, resolve interpersonal conflict, write a strategic message to someone specific, or simulate a scenario with a specific person. Also trigger when the user mentions: "how do I deal with", "how should I talk to", "what would X do if", "help me communicate…
